name: The Tower of Ptah
notes: Built by tools/make_ptah.py. Change that file and run it again, rather than editing this one. Format: see levels/test.json.
You go DOWN here: the way in is at the top, the gem of Ptah at the bottom.
spikes:true on a cell = a bed of spikes on its floor. Touching one kills at once. spikes:'deep' = the same, but too far down to be drawn.
rev: raise it when the level's shape changes. A save made in an older shape starts the level again from its door.

gates: a door that fills one cell. mode key (opens with the item whose 'key' matches), lever (see levers), timed (opens and shuts by itself), auto (opens as you come near). Cells with the same id are one door.
levers: a lever on a wall of a cell ('wall'), working the gates whose id is 'opens'. shooters: a wall mouth that spits fireballs along the passage.
The way up: when the gem is taken, the gate 'wayup' (looks like wall) slides open on a winding stair. Its end is a hole that drops you into the hall's bath.
torchColor: the colour of every torch and fire bowl in the level. lights: fixed lights, such as the glow of a gem.
wallTex hiero / hiero2 = walls carved with hieroglyphs. floorTex / ceilTex / wallTex dark = plain black, for the far sides of a void. secret:true = a false wall.

spots.text: The way back to the hall.
The north wall rings hollow here.
The tower stands alone in the dark. This causeway is the only way across.
The water runs on, down a black tunnel. Cold currents pull away to the east, under the wall.
There is a low opening under the water, to the east.
A draught seeps from a crack in the west wall.
A stair of stone goes down into the dark. You cannot see its end.
Here the first gallery begins. Everything in this tower goes down.
A small dry room above the water. Someone crawled here to die.
The gem of Ptah lies on a plinth in the dark.
The plaster on the west wall here is cracked, and it sounds hollow.
A thin, stale draught comes from low down in the east wall.
The east wall of this vault is plastered over, not cut from the rock like the others.
Tomb robbers hid here once. One of them never left.
A burial, robbed and forgotten. Most of what was left with the dead is smashed.
A narrow stair goes up into the rock. Air moves on it, from somewhere above.
The stair ends at a square hole in the floor. Far below, water glints in a faint light.
